settings.card_1_text: AJAX drawer with a free-shipping meter, three reward tiers, add-on products and gift wrap.
settings.card_2_text: Products, collections, articles and pages as you type, in a popup or inline.

settings.card_4_text: Add from any card without leaving the page.
settings.card_5_text: Pick up to three products on a collection and compare.
settings.card_6_text: Saved items with a header counter and a wishlist page section.

settings.card_4_text: Timers, progress bars and stepped launch progress.
settings.card_5_text: Guest order lookup, fulfillment timeline and region availability.
settings.card_6_text: Currency and language selectors with right-to-left support.
